name: Wenrou zhi Shi
source:
The world has never been fair!
Animals that become "predators" may even not deserve to live in this world at all!
You just want to live, not show your fangs for desire.
You once thought that if you confessed everything to the world, you would be accepted back. And even you took off your "shell" to reveal your most vulnerable parts, but the result was you in black and blue!
Screaming and crying until you summon up the courage to resist, blood fills your nose and mouth. When you are defined as a monster again, all your remains are tolerance and numbness, because you will never have a third chance!
You lost the honor of your parents, crushed your dreams, and endured the trampling of others! Over and over again, your despair and endless pain are like a black hole, pulling you into the abyss and trapping you up!
But you may have forgotten, child, please look back; those who love you have never abandoned you!

...Hysteria?
